summary:
Create an advanced AI-powered Astronaut Health Monitoring Software designed to monitor astronauts' health continuously during space missions. The system should collect real-time health data using wearable sensors and smart medical devices.
The software should monitor important health parameters such as:
Heart rate monitoring.
Blood pressure monitoring.
Body temperature monitoring.
Oxygen saturation (SpO2).
Respiratory rate monitoring.
Stress and fatigue detection.
Physical activity monitoring.
details: The software should provide a user-friendly dashboard displaying astronaut health status, real-time vital signs, warning notifications, and medical reports.
